text:
maya: dropping a quick prototype for the autoscale confirmation flow: https://www.figma.com/file/PROJ/autoscale-confirm-proto
liam: looks good. one thing: the cost row needs timeframe (per month) and an 'approx' label.
sara: microcopy: header 'Confirm autoscale changes' + CTA 'Apply changes' and helper 'provisions capacity in ~2 minutes' under CTA.
ethan: accessibility: focus should move into modal to the primary CTA, use aria-live for cost/SLO updates, ESC closes the modal.
olivia: product: top summary row (cost delta / 99p latency delta / pool) is super useful. make it collapsible for mobile.
maya: added the summary row. Q: if min == max, should burst toggle be interactive? I think disable with tooltip.
liam: agree. tooltip copy: 'Burst requires headroom: increase max to enable short spikes.' keeps it actionable.
sara: copy tweak: 'estimated cost impact' -> 'estimated monthly cost change (approx.)' and add 'assumptions' link to open a tiny panel listing tokens/hr and avg seq len.
ben: pool selector: show compact pool chips with GPUs free + latency tier. if selected pool doesn't support burst, show inline note and disable burst.
ethan: dev note: debounce estimate calls on slider changes (250-300ms), cancel inflight, show skeleton in summary while computing.
maya: also request subtle number animation on delta changes and respect reduced-motion.
deploy-bot: uploaded image -> autoscale-confirm-proto.png
olivia: acceptance criteria draft: estimates update <200ms median, skeleton appears on compute, disabled burst shows tooltip, chips collapse on mobile.
maya: thanks all. i'll push updates to figma and ping when prototype is in staging. :thumbsup:
